title: Who Moved My Cheese?
author: Spencer Johnson
summary: A short parable about two mice and two tiny people living in a maze, who respond differently when their supply of cheese disappears. It is meant as a lesson about adapting to change in work and life.
readIf: you want a very quick, simple story to think about handling change.
skipIf: you want depth or evidence, since the message is stated in a thin parable.
